scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Chosen ones who are destined to become Gods
are so many in this era
but they never realise their fate while alive.
They end up to become ordinary men...
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
这时代，多少天选之人，注定成为神明。
却终其一生，不知自己的命运。
最终，仍是凡人...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Wind and Clouds, please send this message to them,
who pursue food, clothing, shelter and wealth.
Tell them they are wasting their time...
Tell them they forget the most important goal of the life...
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
风与云啊，请替我传话，告诉那些追逐衣食、居所与财富的人。
告诉他们，他们在虚度光阴...
告诉他们，他们遗忘了人生最重要的目标...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Ooh hey! How's your singing these days?
I wonder if your voice got any better.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
哦，嘿！最近歌唱得怎么样？
嗓音有没有更动听些？

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
You don't forget to spread good news in each town, right?
And don't forget to learn new songs, too...
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
没忘了在各个城镇传播好消息吧？
也别忘了学些新歌...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Never forget to have a positive attitude and the meaning of joy.
Our songs are supposed to deliver happiness and joy to everyone.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
别忘了保持乐观，也别忘了快乐的意义。
我们的歌声，要把幸福与喜悦带给每个人。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
The sadness that overcomes my heart.. 
It will not reside..
Is this the reason behind my troubles,
is this why I am weak,
This must be why I cannot seem to forget you...
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
悲伤笼罩心头...
却不愿停留...
是它令我烦忧，是它使我软弱？
一定是它，让我始终无法忘记你...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Oh, sorry. I didn't see you because I was concentrating on writing some lyrics.
Do you want to listen to my songs? Shall I sing a song for you?
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
啊，抱歉，我专心写歌词，没注意到你。
想听我的歌吗？要不要给你唱一首？

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Heh... try asking someone else.
I'm trying to compose a new song.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
嘿...去问别人吧。
我正忙着写新歌。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Lalala, lalala. Beautiful Comodo.
Always full of happy moments~
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
Lalala, lalala. 美丽的克魔岛。
总有快乐的时光~

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Forget about your worries~
And enjoy everything~
Youth never repeats itself~
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
忘掉你的烦恼吧~
尽情享受一切~
青春一去不复返~

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Cute lady, shall we dance~
Youth never repeats itself~
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
可爱的姑娘，来跳支舞吧~
青春一去不复返~

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Hi! Delightful Archer.
How can a wanderer like me help you?
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
你好，快乐的弓箭手！
我这个流浪者，能帮你些什么？

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Hello! Beautiful Archer Lady.
How can a wanderer like me help you?
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
你好，美丽的弓箭手小姐！
我这个流浪者，能帮你些什么？

scripts.text: You have a nice voice.
scripts.translation: 你的声音真好听

scripts.text: Could you sing for me, please?
scripts.translation: 请为我唱首歌好吗？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Hahaha! Of course!
if you sing with a happy heart, your voice always gets better.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
Hahaha! 那当然！
怀着快乐的心歌唱，嗓音自然会更动听。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
But, to Bards your voice is your life.
Sometimes your voice will go, but you must be careful.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
不过，对诗人来说，嗓子就是生命。
有时候会失声，所以一定要小心保护。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
A song... let's see.
Ok, I got one...
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
唱首歌...让我想想。
好，有了...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
I'll sing.. Drums of War.
*ehem...*cough...gag..mememememe...
1, 2, 3, 4...
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
我要唱...《战鼓》。
*ehem...*cough...gag..mememememe...
1, 2, 3, 4...

scripts.text:
^000088The sound of horses galloping over the horizon
The dust that covers the distant sun
When thousands of eyes open in the night sky
The castle's fire will burn with power.^000000
scripts.translation:
^000088马蹄声越过天际，
扬起的尘土遮住远方的太阳。
当千万双眼睛在夜空睁开，
城堡的火焰将熊熊燃烧。^000000

scripts.text:
^000088I can hear.. the beating of my heart.
I can feel.. the blood rushing through my veins.
.. and the weight of my armor.
I can see.. my enemies.^000000
scripts.translation:
^000088我能听见...我的心跳。
我能感觉到...血液在血管中奔涌。
...还有铠甲的重量。
我能看见...我的敌人。^000000

scripts.text:
^000088Louder, louder louder..
Give strength to the warriors!
Higher, higher, higher..
This day will never come again!^000000
scripts.translation:
^000088更响，更响，更响...
赐予战士们力量吧！
更高，更高，更高...
这一天将不再重演！^000000

scripts.text:
^000088Shake the sky and roar through the land.
Make my heart pound again!
Let the trumpets sound, and castle walls ring.
This moment will never come again!^000000
scripts.translation:
^000088震撼苍穹，声震大地。
让我的心再次激荡！
吹响号角，让城墙回响。
这一刻一去不复返！^000000

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Hmm... that's always a good song to sing.
How was it? Don't you think it's a nice song?
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
嗯...这首歌，唱起来总让人痛快。
怎么样，好听吧？

scripts.text: Yes, it was very nice.
scripts.translation: 是的，非常好听

scripts.text: No, not really...
scripts.translation: 不怎么好听...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Thanks! if you enjoyed my song, it makes me happy, too.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
谢谢！你喜欢我的歌，我也很开心。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
It would be nice if more people went around and sang...
Well, it's quite ok as it is now... hmmhmm.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
要是有更多人四处歌唱，就好了...
不过，现在这样也不错...hmmhmm.

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
if you ever want to hear my song again, just ask.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
如果你以后还想听我唱歌，尽管开口。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Hmm... Did I lose my senses, I'll have to try harder.
Anyways.. Thanks for listening.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
嗯...难道我的感觉不灵了？得再努力点。
总之...谢谢你听我唱歌。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Oy, not requesting a song when you run into a Bard isn't very polite.
Well... can't help it since you look like you're in a hurry anyways.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
哎，遇见诗人却不点首歌，可不太礼貌哦。
不过...看你急着赶路，就算了。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Hunting is good... but you can't forget to relax once in a while.
Youth is short and won't come again once it passes by..
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
打猎是好事...可也别忘了偶尔放松。
青春短暂，一去不复返...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Hey there Archer fellow.
How can a wanderer like me help you?
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
嘿，弓箭手朋友！
我这个流浪者，能帮你些什么？

scripts.text: You have a nice voice.
scripts.translation: 你的声音真好听

scripts.text: Could you sing for me, please?
scripts.translation: 请为我唱首歌好吗？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Hoho, your voice is rather nice as well?
Ever think about singing?
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
Hoho，你的嗓音也很不错嘛。
有没有想过唱歌？

scripts.text: Of course!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text: I can't quite possibly...
scripts.translation: 我恐怕不行...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Haha, nice attitude. You have to be like that to become a Bard.
I'll help you become a Bard then.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
Haha，态度不错！成为诗人，就得有这股劲头。
那我来帮你转职吧。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
But before that... do you think you can bring me a Flower?
I need to smell the scent of a Flower to feel like teaching.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
不过，先给我带朵花，怎么样？
闻到花香，我才有心情教你。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
It doesn't really matter which Flower, but try to bring one that I like.
And don't just buy any random Flower, ok?
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
哪种花倒无所谓，不过，最好是我喜欢的。
可别随便买朵花来敷衍哦。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Haha, what a timid one.
Don't think so little of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
Haha，真是个胆怯的家伙。
别这么看轻自己。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
You have plenty of talent.
Come again if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
你很有天赋。
改变主意，就再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Hmm... seems like you have some singing talents?
Don't just request songs.. singing to others is quite fun, too.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
嗯...看来你有唱歌的天赋？
别光点歌，唱给别人听，也很有趣。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Try enjoying your life as a Bard.
You go from town to town, singing to the people. Doesn't it sound great?
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
体验一下诗人的生活吧。
走遍各个城镇，为人们歌唱，听起来很棒吧？

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Hmm... I'm not sure what's what, but enjoy life.
You look too uptight.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
嗯...不管怎么回事，好好享受生活吧。
你看起来太拘谨了。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Well then~ Have a great time~
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
那么~祝你玩得开心~

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Welcome! Archer friend.
Did you bring a Flower? Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
欢迎，弓箭手朋友！
花带来了吗？让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Ooh! It's a Singing Flower!
It's full of my memories...
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
哦！呢喃花！
它承载着我许多回忆...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Aah... the cute Hinelle...
It doesn't have a scent but it's a very moderate cute flower.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
啊...可爱的西纳雷花...
虽然没有香气，却朴素可爱。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Aloe... This is a rare flower.
How'd you get it? Rather skilled, eh?
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
芦荟...这可是稀有的花。
怎么弄到的？挺有本事嘛。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Ment... You can forget about all your hardships with one of these.
Nice to see it in such a long time!
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
薄荷...有它就能忘掉一切辛劳。
好久不见，真让人高兴！

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Ooh, isn't this an Izidor?
It's a dangerous yet beautiful flower...
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
噢，这不是迷幻药吗？
这是一种危险却又美丽的花...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Ooh, a Witherless Rose. The strong flower that doesn't wither.
Great to give to a girlfriend.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
哦，永恒玫瑰，坚韧而永不凋谢的花。
最适合送给女朋友了。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Frozen Rose... you can't really call this a flower,
But it is still beautiful... a clear Rose.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
冰雕玫瑰...虽说不能算真正的花，却依然美丽...
一朵晶莹剔透的玫瑰。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Oh, isn't this an Illusion Flower!?
Wow, how did you obtain such a rare flower!!
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
哦，这不是幻想花吗？！
哇，你怎么弄到这么稀有的花！

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Eh? This is just a normal flower.
I like it... but it's not enough.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
咦？只是朵普通的花。
我倒是喜欢...可还不够。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Oh no, you brought a Bouquet?
You can't bring me something like this.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
哎呀，你带的是捧花？
这种可不行。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Oy oy... did you go to a wedding or something?
What do you expect a guy to do with a Wedding Bouquet?
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
哎，哎...你去参加婚礼了？
给我个大男人带捧花，要我拿它做什么？

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Mmm... a Fancy Flower.
It's nice... but this isn't good enough.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
嗯...花朵头饰。
是不错...不过，还不够。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
...Agh, why'd you bring such a hideous thing?
Are you thinking at all?
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
...啊，怎么带来这么难看的东西？
你到底有没有动脑筋？

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Hmm? What... you didnt' bring anything.
Didn't I ask you to bring a flower?
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
嗯？什么...你什么都没带。
我不是让你带朵花来吗？

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
My friend Tchaikovsky used to like it.
I wonder what he's doing now...
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
我的朋友柴可夫斯基以前很喜欢它。
不知道他现在在做什么...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
The leaves gave me strength when I used to fall.
I really like this flower, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
以前我倒下时，这花的叶子给了我力量。
我很喜欢这朵花，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
The leaves are good and Aloe Vera is delicious, too..
but it's defnitely the most beautiful when it's a flower.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
叶子很不错，芦荟也很好吃...
不过，还是开花时最美。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
I heard you can make Anodyne with it...
But that would be a slight waste.. thanks!
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
听说能用它制作麻醉剂...
不过，那可有点浪费...谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
The deep purple charms a person.. 
Thank you, I really like this flower.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
深紫色真迷人...
谢谢，我很喜欢这朵花。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
I wonder if it would be ok for a wanderer like me to accept it.
Haha, it should be ok.. right?
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
我这个流浪者，收下它合适吗？
Haha，应该没问题...对吧？

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
You can call it a flower even though it doesn't have a scent anymore.
Then I'll greatly take this.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
虽然已没了香气，但仍称得上是花。
那我就高高兴兴地收下了。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Than you very much, aah... I feel like heaven is in front of my eyes.
What a wonderful feeling! I'm really happy!
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
太感谢了，啊...仿佛天堂就在眼前。
多么美妙，真开心！

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
You can get this flower from the girl in Prontera.
Please bring me a different flower.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
这花在普隆德拉的女孩那里就能弄到。
换一种带给我吧。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Go give this to a graduating Sage or something.
Since it's great as that kind of gift... Bring a different flower.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
拿去送给毕业的贤者吧，很适合当毕业礼物...
给我换一种花。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
It's not me. Go give it to a lady or something.
This isn't the type of flower I wanted.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
我可不要，拿去送给姑娘吧。
这不是我要的花。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
I like flowers that have a scent and are beautiful.
I don't like fake flowers that go on top of heads.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
我喜欢美丽、有香气的花，不喜欢戴在头上的假花。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
if you were trying to be funny, it was a good attempt...
but bring a normal flower now.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
要是想逗我笑，倒是做得不错...
不过，现在还是带朵正常的花来吧。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Well... if you want to learn on your own, then so be it.
Anyone can just go out and sing.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
嗯...想自学，就随你吧。
谁都可以走出去唱歌。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
As I promised, I'll help you become a Bard.
But it's not easy my friend. Haha!
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
按约定，我会帮你成为诗人。
不过，朋友，这可不容易。
Haha!

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
It is important to get to know a lot of people to learn how to sing.
You must also keep up with all the things going on in different villages...
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
学习歌唱，结识各式各样的人很重要。
还得留心各个村庄发生的事...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
There's a talking snowman in a town called Lutie.
Go there and bring back a present.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
姜饼城有个会说话的雪人。
去一趟，带份礼物回来。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
if you become friends with ^008800Jack Frost^000000, you will receive something.
And also talk to the townspeople while you're at it...
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
和^008800杰克·弗罗斯特^000000交上朋友，就能得到东西。
顺便也和镇上的居民聊聊...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
How was the trip? Did you meet a lot of people?
You should have been able to learn something more important than a gift.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
旅途如何？认识了不少人吧？
你应该学到了比礼物更重要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Then, do you want to try singing...?
I'll sing a short melody...
and you try after.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
那么，试着唱唱吧...？
我先唱一小段，你再跟着唱。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Here I go.
Ehem *clears throat*
1, 2, 3, 4
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
开始了。
Ehem *清清嗓子*
1, 2, 3, 4

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Eh, you still haven't become his friend?
Talking will not be enough.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
咦，还没和他交上朋友？
光聊天可不够。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
if you become friends with ^008800Jack Frost^000000, you will receive something.
And talk with the village people, too...
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
和^008800杰克·弗罗斯特^000000交上朋友，就能得到东西。
也别忘了和村民们聊聊...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Hmm... this time you can do better, right?
Let's try again, you can do it.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
嗯...这次能唱得更好吧？
再来一次，你能做到。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
I'll sing one part...
and you try it after.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
我先唱一段，你跟着唱...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Here we go.
*Ehem*
1, 2, 3, 4
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
开始了。
*Ehem*
1, 2, 3, 4

who was said to be immortal.^000000

Son of the hero Jichmunt.
The evil giant Papner,
Turned into a dragon and ate him.
scripts.translation:
^3377FF有一位男子
据说拥有不死之身。^000000
他名叫吉克弗里德，
是英雄吉克蒙特之子。
邪恶的巨人帕普纳，
化身为龙，将他吞噬。

scripts.text:

who was said to be immortal.

scripts.text:
^3377FFA Merchant without money or equipment,^000000
a Merchant that couldn't sell anything.
But he was too proud to beg.
So he gathered some money selling items.
At first he only sold Red Potions.
Some say he sold Sweet Potatoes, too.
scripts.translation:
^3377FF一个没有钱、没有装备的商人，^000000
一个什么都卖不出去的商人。
可他自尊太强，不肯乞讨。
于是，他靠卖东西攒了些钱。
起初，他只卖红色药水。
有人说，他也卖过红薯。

^3377FFAll Gods never age.^000000
The ever so Beautiful Goddess Eden,
Beautiful and graceful Goddess Eden,
Odin's daughter-in-law and Bragi's wife.
Her sweet apples in her basket,
All thanks to her sweet apples.
scripts.translation:
^3377FF众神永不衰老。^000000
美丽绝伦的女神伊甸，
美丽优雅的女神伊甸，
奥丁的儿媳，布拉基的妻子。
她篮子里甜美的苹果，
全都要归功于她甜美的苹果。

scripts.text:
^3377FFBragi, Bragi,^000000
Forever call the poets name.
My songs are his breath,
My mind is his will,
All wandering poets are his people,
And all praise shall go to him.
scripts.translation:
^3377FF布拉基，布拉基，^000000
永远传颂诗人的名号。
我的歌声是他的呼吸，
我的思想是他的意志，
所有流浪的诗人都是他的子民，
所有的赞美都归于他。

scripts.text:
^3377FFLouder, louder, louder.^000000
Give strength to the warriors!
Shake the sky and roar through the land.
Make my heart pound again!
Let the castle walls ring.
This day will never come again!
scripts.translation:
^3377FF更响，更响，更响。^000000
赐予战士们力量吧！
震撼苍穹，声震大地。
让我的心再次激荡！
让城墙回响。
这一天一去不复返！

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Oy, You got the lyrics wrong!
Can't you even sing along..?
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
哎，歌词唱错了！
连跟着唱都不会吗...？

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Your pronunciation is very unclear.
Do a better job next time.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
你的咬字太含糊了。
下次唱清楚些。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Wonderful! Finished it in one try!
You can become a great Bard.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
太棒了！一遍就唱对了！
你能成为出色的诗人。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Mmm... So you will not become a Bard.
But I want to give you a souvenir...
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
嗯...看来你不会成为诗人了。
不过，我还是想送你份纪念品...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Do you want to just change jobs now?
Or do you want a present.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
现在就转职，还是先要份礼物？

scripts.text: Just change my job please.
scripts.translation: 请直接帮我转职

scripts.text: I'd be thankful for a present.
scripts.translation: 那就谢谢你的礼物了

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Ah... Everything is good, but you still have some skill points left.
Go learn the rest of the skills and come back.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
啊...其他都没问题，可你还有没用完的技能点。
先去学完技能，再回来。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
And I am going to give you a small present...
So bring some trunks.
It doesn't matter what kind, as long as they are 60 of the same kind...
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
我还要送你份小礼物...
所以，带些树干来。
哪种都行，只要同一种带足60个...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Mmm? Seems like you haven't prepared all trunks the yet? 
Do you want to just change jobs anyways?
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
嗯？树干还没准备齐？
要不就直接转职？

scripts.text: Yes, just change my job already.
scripts.translation: 好，直接转职吧

scripts.text: No, I'll go prepare them.
scripts.translation: 不，我去准备

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Very well! Hope you sing happy enjoyable songs.
Live like the wind and the clouds!
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
很好！希望你唱出欢快动听的歌。
像风与云一样，自由地生活！

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
See you again next time!
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
下次再见！

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Hmm... very well, bring some trunks.
It doesn't matter what kind, as long as they are 60 of the same kind...
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
嗯...好，带些树干来。
哪种都行，只要同一种带足60个...

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
I will give you a gift once you bring them.
Have a safe trip.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
带来之后，我就送你份礼物。
路上小心。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Whee~ whee~ whee~
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
Whee~ whee~ whee~

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Good job. I will make you a job change souvenir with this.
Wait just a moment.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
做得好，我用这些给你做份转职纪念品。
稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
^3355FFScrape Scrape Tang Tang^000000
^3355FFSqueak Squeak Scratch Scratch^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
^3355FFScrape Scrape Tang Tang^000000
^3355FFSqueak Squeak Scratch Scratch^000000

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
Here you go, a souvenir. It is useful when you sing.
Hope you sing happy songs.
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
给你，纪念品，唱歌时用得上。
愿你唱出快乐的歌。

scripts.text:
[Lalo]
See you next time!
scripts.translation:
[拉洛]
下次再见！
